trello.name: Fix Staging Environment Deploy Job
trello.desc: The staging environment is currently broken because the CI deploy job cannot pull the base image due to an expired registry token. Steps to resolve: 1) Regenerate the registry token. 2) Update the CI secret with the newly generated token. 3) Re-run the staging deploy job. Acceptance criteria: The staging deploy job completes successfully (turns green) and the staging environment is accessible for testing. Target completion: within 1 hour.

trello.name: Send Updated Meridian Proposal to Lena
trello.desc: Meridian requested an updated proposal with the new pricing, which was promised to them by the end of the day today. Steps to resolve: 1) Locate the final pricing numbers in the approved spreadsheet. 2) Update the proposal document with these numbers. 3) Find Lena's (Meridian's procurement contact) email address in the original kickoff thread. 4) Send the updated proposal document to Lena. Acceptance criteria: The updated proposal is emailed to Lena by the end of the day.
